lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's one hundred forty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 140? Nope!

lines.text: Five pairs of socks, each a different color. Pull out four.
lines.caption: 5 pairs of socks, each a different color. Pull out 4.

lines.text: How many sets of four contain at least one matching pair?
lines.caption: How many sets of 4 contain at least one matching pair?

lines.text: No pair means four different colors. Leave one color out: five ways.
lines.caption: No pair means 4 different colors. Leave one color out: 5 ways.

lines.text: Each color has two socks to pick from. Two times two times two times two is sixteen.
lines.caption: Each color has 2 socks to pick from. 2×2×2×2 is 16.

lines.text: So five times sixteen is eighty sets with no pair.
lines.caption: So 5 times 16 is 80 sets with no pair.

lines.text: There are two hundred ten sets in all. Take away eighty: one hundred thirty!
lines.caption: There are 210 sets in all. Take away 80: 130!

lines.text: One hundred forty was the trap. It counts two-pair sets twice.
lines.caption: 140 was the trap. It counts two-pair sets twice.

lines.text: Did you get one hundred thirty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 130? Tell me below!
